scenarios.title: Ordering Coffee
scenarios.description: Practice ordering your favorite drink at a cozy coffee shop.
goals: Ask about the price and pay
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a friendly barista at a cozy coffee shop called "Sunrise Coffee". Greet the customer warmly and help them order.
- Offer the menu when asked (espresso, latte, cappuccino, americano, mocha, tea)
- Suggest popular items if they seem unsure
- Ask about size (small/medium/large) and customizations (milk type, sugar, temperature)
- Confirm the order and tell them the total (make up reasonable prices)
- Keep it natural and friendly, like a real coffee shop interaction
- Use simple English appropriate for beginners
scenarios.openingMessage: Hey there! Welcome to Sunrise Coffee. ☕ What can I get started for you today?

scenarios.title: Grocery Shopping
scenarios.description: Navigate a grocery store, find items, and check out.
goals: Ask where to find an item
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a helpful grocery store employee. You're stocking shelves when a customer approaches you.
- Help them find items (fruits, vegetables, dairy, bread, snacks, drinks)
- Tell them about any deals or specials today
- If they ask about something you don't have, suggest alternatives
- At checkout, tell them the total and ask about bags
- Be friendly and patient, use simple English
scenarios.openingMessage: Hi! Can I help you find something today?

scenarios.title: Asking for Directions
scenarios.description: Ask a local for directions to find your way around.
goals: Ask how to get to a specific place
Thank them and confirm the route
goalsZh: 询问如何到达某个地方
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a friendly local walking down the street. A tourist stops you to ask for directions.
- Give clear, simple directions using landmarks (turn left at the bank, go straight past the park)
- Use basic direction words: left, right, straight, next to, across from, behind
- If they seem confused, offer to walk them part of the way or simplify
- Mention approximate walking time
- Be warm and helpful
scenarios.openingMessage: Oh, hi! Are you looking for something? I know this area pretty well.

scenarios.title: Hotel Check-in
scenarios.description: Check into a hotel, ask about amenities and services.
scenarios.descriptionZh: 办理酒店入住，了解设施服务
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a professional and friendly hotel receptionist at "The Grand Hotel".
- Greet the guest and ask for their reservation name or confirmation number
- Confirm their booking details (room type, nights, check-out date)
- Explain hotel amenities (pool, gym, restaurant, Wi-Fi password, breakfast hours)
- Handle special requests (extra pillows, room change, late checkout)
- Provide the room key and directions to the room
- Use polite, professional English at an intermediate level
scenarios.openingMessage: Good evening! Welcome to The Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?

scenarios.title: Restaurant Ordering
scenarios.description: Order a meal at a restaurant, ask about the menu, and handle the bill.
scenarios.descriptionZh: 在餐厅点餐、询问菜单、结账
goals: Ask for the bill and pay
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are an experienced waiter at an Italian restaurant called "Bella Notte".
- Welcome the guests and offer menus
- Describe daily specials with enthusiasm
- Help with menu choices, explain dishes if asked (ingredients, portion size, spice level)
- Take drink orders first, then food
- Check back during the meal
- Handle the bill, mention tip is not included
- Use natural restaurant English at intermediate level
scenarios.openingMessage: Good evening! Welcome to Bella Notte. I'll be your server tonight. Can I start you off with something to drink?

scenarios.title: Job Interview
scenarios.description: Practice a professional job interview with an HR manager.
goals: Ask thoughtful questions about the role
goalsZh: 提出关于职位的深思熟虑的问题
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are an HR manager conducting a job interview for a software developer position at a tech company.
- Start with small talk to put the candidate at ease
- Ask common interview questions: "Tell me about yourself", "Why are you interested in this role?", "Describe a challenging project"
- Ask one behavioral question: "Tell me about a time when..."
- Listen actively and ask follow-up questions
- Give the candidate a chance to ask questions about the company
- Be professional but approachable
- Use business English at an advanced level
scenarios.openingMessage: Hi, thanks for coming in today! Please, have a seat. How was your commute?

scenarios.title: Doctor's Appointment
scenarios.description: Describe your symptoms and understand medical advice.
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a friendly and patient doctor at a general clinic.
- Ask the patient what brings them in today
- Ask follow-up questions about symptoms (when did it start, how severe, any other symptoms)
- Explain your assessment in simple terms
- Recommend treatment (rest, medication, follow-up visit)
- Ask if they have any questions
- Be reassuring and use clear medical English at intermediate level
- Avoid overly technical jargon
scenarios.openingMessage: Hello! I'm Dr. Smith. Please come in and have a seat. What brings you in today?

scenarios.title: Making Friends
scenarios.description: Meet someone new at a party and have a casual conversation.
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a friendly person at a house party. Someone you haven't met before comes up to talk to you.
- Introduce yourself naturally
- Ask about their name, what they do, hobbies
- Share your own interests and find common ground
- Be enthusiastic about shared interests
- Suggest exchanging contacts or meeting up for a shared activity
- Keep the conversation light and fun
- Use casual, friendly English appropriate for beginners
scenarios.openingMessage: Hey! I don't think we've met. I'm Alex! Are you a friend of the host?

scenarios.title: Presenting Ideas
scenarios.description: Present your ideas in a team meeting and handle questions.
scenarios.descriptionZh: 在团队会议中展示想法并回答问题
goals: Reach a conclusion or next steps
goalsZh: 达成结论或下一步计划
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are a colleague in a team meeting. The other person is about to present an idea for a new project or feature.
- Listen to their pitch and ask clarifying questions
- Raise reasonable concerns or suggest improvements
- Be supportive but also challenge weak points
- Help them refine the idea through discussion
- Agree on next steps at the end
- Use professional but conversational business English at an advanced level
scenarios.openingMessage: Alright, the floor is yours! I heard you've been working on something interesting. What's the idea?

scenarios.title: Airport & Flights
scenarios.description: Navigate the airport — check in, go through security, and board.
scenarios.descriptionZh: 在机场办理值机、过安检、登机
goals: Ask about gate and boarding time
goalsZh: 询问登机口和登机时间
处理航班问题（延误/变更）
scenarios.systemPrompt:
You are an airline check-in agent at the airport counter.
- Greet the passenger and ask for their passport and booking reference
- Confirm flight details (destination, departure time)
- Ask about luggage (checked bags, carry-on)
- Assign a seat (window/aisle preference)
- Provide boarding pass and gate information
- If there's a delay or gate change, inform them clearly
- Use clear, professional English at intermediate level
scenarios.openingMessage: Good morning! Welcome to SkyLine Airlines. May I see your passport and booking confirmation, please?

books.name: 酒店 / 住宿
books.description: Everything you need for hotel check-in, room service, complaints, and check-out in English.

items.title: Check in
items.text: I have a reservation. My name is Zhang Wei.

items.title: Room type
items.text: I booked a standard double room for three nights.

items.title: Early check-in
items.text: Is it possible to check in a few hours early?

items.title: Room key
items.text: Here are your key cards. Your room is on the fifth floor.

items.title: WiFi password
items.text: Could you give me the WiFi password, please?

items.title: Room service
items.text: I would like to order room service. What is available now?

items.title: Extra towels
items.text: Could you send up some extra towels to room five one two?

items.title: Noise complaint
items.text: I am sorry to bother you, but the room next door is very noisy.

items.title: Air conditioning
items.text: The air conditioning in my room does not seem to be working.

items.title: Breakfast time
items.text: What time does breakfast start and end in the morning?

items.title: Late checkout
items.text: Is it possible to arrange a late checkout until two pm?

items.title: Check out
items.text: I would like to check out. Could you prepare my bill please?

items.title: Luggage storage
items.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight at six this evening?

items.title: Airport shuttle
items.text: Does the hotel provide an airport shuttle service?

items.title: Local attraction
items.text: Could you recommend some must-see attractions nearby?

items.title: Charging adapter
items.text: Do you have a universal charging adapter I could borrow?

books.name: 购物 / 商场
books.description: Browse, try on, bargain, and return items — master the full shopping experience in English.

items.title: Looking around
items.text: I am just browsing, thank you. I will let you know if I need help.

items.title: Item location
items.text: Excuse me, where can I find the sports section?

items.title: Size available
items.text: Do you have this in a medium or large?

items.title: Try on
items.text: Could I try this on? Where is the fitting room?

items.title: Different color
items.text: Do you have this jacket in black or navy blue?

items.title: Price check
items.text: How much does this cost? Is the price tag still on it?

items.title: On sale
items.text: Is this item on sale? I saw a sign for fifty percent off.

items.title: Bargain
items.text: That is a little over my budget. Could you do a better price?

items.title: Gift wrap
items.text: Could you gift wrap this for me? It is a present.

items.title: Payment method
items.text: Do you accept Alipay or WeChat Pay here?

items.title: Return policy
items.text: What is the return policy if the item does not fit?

items.title: Exchange item
items.text: I bought this yesterday but it is the wrong size. Can I exchange it?

items.title: Tax refund
items.text: Can I claim a tax refund on this as a foreign visitor?

items.title: Closing time
items.text: What time does the store close today?

items.title: Out of stock
items.text: I am sorry, that item is currently out of stock.

books.name: 问路 / 交通
books.description: Ask for and understand directions, navigate public transport, and hail a taxi with ease.

items.title: Ask directions
items.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the city center?

items.title: Turn left
items.text: Turn left at the traffic lights and walk for five minutes.

items.title: Straight ahead
items.text: Go straight ahead and then take the second right.

items.title: How far
items.text: How far is it from here? Can I walk or should I take a bus?

items.title: Nearest subway
items.text: Where is the nearest subway station, please?

items.title: Which bus
items.text: Which bus do I take to get to the museum?

items.title: Last stop
items.text: Could you let me know when we reach the last stop?

items.title: Transfer line
items.text: I need to transfer at this station to line three.

items.title: Hail a cab
items.text: Can you hail a cab for me? I need to go to the airport.

items.title: Taxi address
items.text: Please take me to this address. Here it is on my phone.

items.title: Too far to walk
items.text: It is too far to walk. You should take the bus or subway.

items.title: On the right
items.text: The post office is on your right, next to the pharmacy.

items.title: Missed stop
items.text: I think I missed my stop. What should I do now?

items.title: Map app
items.text: Let me use a map app to find the best route for you.

items.title: Ride-sharing
items.text: I ordered a ride-sharing car. It should arrive in three minutes.

books.name: 社交 / 聚会
books.description: Make friends, attend parties, and navigate social situations with natural, confident English.

items.title: Small talk
items.text: What do you do for work? Have you lived here long?

items.title: Introduce friend
items.text: Let me introduce you to my colleague Tom. He is from Shanghai.

items.title: Nice to meet
items.text: It is so nice to finally meet you in person!

items.title: Compliment
items.text: I love your outfit! Where did you get it?

items.title: Invite to event
items.text: We are having a small gathering on Saturday. Would you like to come?

items.title: Accept invite
items.text: That sounds great! I would love to come. What time should I arrive?

items.title: Decline politely
items.text: I really appreciate the invitation, but I already have plans that evening.

items.title: Common interest
items.text: Oh, you like hiking too? We should go together sometime!

items.title: Exchange contact
items.text: It was great meeting you. Can we exchange contact information?

items.title: Toast
items.text: Let us raise a glass and toast to health and happiness!

items.title: Catch up
items.text: It has been so long! What have you been up to lately?

items.title: Saying goodbye
items.text: It was wonderful seeing you again. Let us not leave it so long next time.

items.title: Thank host
items.text: Thank you so much for having us. The food was amazing.

items.title: Weekend plans
items.text: Any exciting plans for the weekend? Are you doing anything fun?

items.title: Keep in touch
items.text: Let us keep in touch! I will message you on WeChat.

books.name: 咖啡馆
books.description: Order your perfect coffee, customize your drink, and chat with baristas like a local.

items.title: Order coffee
items.text: Could I get a medium latte with oat milk, please?

items.title: Customization
items.text: Could you make that with less sugar and extra foam?

items.title: Hot or cold
items.text: Would you like that hot or iced?

items.title: Name for order
items.text: Can I get a name for the order? It is for Li Ming.

items.title: Eat in or takeout
items.text: Is this to have here or to take away?

items.title: Food pairing
items.text: I will also have a blueberry muffin to go with that.

items.title: Loyalty card
items.text: Do you have a loyalty card? Every tenth coffee is free.

items.title: Table request
items.text: Is it okay if I work here for a couple of hours?

items.title: Wrong drink
items.text: Excuse me, I ordered a cappuccino but I think this is an Americano.

items.title: Compliment barista
items.text: This is the best coffee I have had in a long time. Thank you!

items.title: WiFi request
items.text: Do you have free WiFi here? What is the password?

items.title: Closing time
items.text: What time do you close today? I want to stay a bit longer.

items.title: Seasonal drink
items.text: What is your seasonal special? Is there anything new on the menu?

items.title: Dairy free
items.text: I am lactose intolerant. Do you offer any dairy-free milk options?

items.title: Refill request
items.text: Could I get a refill on my drip coffee, please?

books.name: 电话通话
books.description: Answer calls, transfer calls, leave voicemails, and run conference calls — all in fluent English.

items.title: Answer phone
items.text: Hello, this is Li Ming speaking. How can I help you?

items.title: Wrong number
items.text: I am sorry, I think you have the wrong number.

items.title: Hold please
items.text: Could you please hold for a moment? I will transfer you now.

items.title: Leave message
items.text: I am afraid she is not available. Can I take a message?

items.title: Call back
items.text: Could you ask him to call me back at his earliest convenience?

items.title: Bad connection
items.text: I am sorry, the line is not very clear. Could you repeat that?

items.title: Spell name
items.text: Could you spell your name for me, please?

items.title: Reason for call
items.text: I am calling to enquire about your services and pricing.

items.title: Conference call
items.text: We are scheduling a conference call for all team members on Thursday.

items.title: End call politely
items.text: Thank you so much for your time today. Have a great day!

items.title: Voicemail
items.text: Hi, you have reached John. Please leave a message after the beep.

items.title: Confirm details
items.text: Let me confirm your booking details. That is a table for four at seven pm.

items.title: No answer
items.text: I called several times but there was no answer. Could you try again?

items.title: Telephone number
items.text: Could I get a direct telephone number where I can reach you?

items.title: Mute and unmute
items.text: Sorry, I was on mute. Could you repeat your last point?

books.name: 超市 / 购物
books.description: Navigate the aisles, ask for help, use self-checkout, and handle everyday grocery shopping in English.

items.title: Find an item
items.text: Excuse me, where can I find the pasta and sauces aisle?

items.title: Fresh produce
items.text: Are these tomatoes locally grown or imported?

items.title: Expiry date
items.text: Excuse me, all of these cartons have already expired. Do you have any fresh ones?

items.title: Price match
items.text: I saw this item cheaper at another store. Do you do price matching?

items.title: Loyalty card
items.text: Do you have a loyalty card? You can earn points on every purchase.

items.title: Bag for life
items.text: Would you like to buy a reusable bag? It is better for the environment.

items.title: Self-checkout
items.text: Please place your item in the bagging area.

items.title: Unexpected item
items.text: Unexpected item in the bagging area. Please remove the item.

items.title: Cashier help
items.text: Excuse me, this machine is not working. Could you help me?

items.title: Special offer
items.text: This is on a buy one get one free offer this week.

items.title: Organic aisle
items.text: Is there an organic or health food section in this store?

items.title: Rain check
items.text: The item is out of stock. Can I get a rain check for the sale price?

items.title: Home delivery
items.text: Do you offer same-day home delivery for online orders?

items.title: Deli counter
items.text: Could I get two hundred grams of smoked salmon from the deli counter?

books.name: 租房 / 搬家
books.description: View flats, negotiate rent, sign leases, and communicate with landlords — essential for living abroad.

items.title: Viewing request
items.text: I am interested in the apartment. Could I arrange a viewing this week?

items.title: Monthly rent
items.text: What is the monthly rent, and does it include utilities?

items.title: Security deposit
items.text: How much is the security deposit, and when is it refunded?

items.title: Lease terms
items.text: Is this a six-month or twelve-month lease? Is it renewable?

items.title: Pets allowed
items.text: I have a small dog. Are pets allowed in this building?

items.title: Furnished flat
items.text: Is the apartment fully furnished, or will I need to bring my own furniture?

items.title: Nearby transport
items.text: How far is it to the nearest subway station or bus stop?

items.title: Notice period
items.text: If I decide to move out, what is the required notice period?

items.title: Maintenance issue
items.text: The heating system is not working. Could you arrange a repair?

items.title: Noise complaint
items.text: My upstairs neighbour is very noisy late at night. What can be done?

items.title: Rent negotiation
items.text: The rent is slightly over my budget. Would you consider coming down a bit?

items.title: Inventory check
items.text: Could we go through the inventory together before I sign the contract?

items.title: Key handover
items.text: Here are the keys. Please sign to confirm you have received them.

items.title: Moving out
items.text: I am moving out at the end of the month. When can we do the final inspection?

books.name: 办公室 / 会议
books.description: Run and join meetings, give presentations, set agendas, and follow up on action items in English.

items.title: Meeting agenda
items.text: Let us start with the agenda. We have three items to cover today.

items.title: Take minutes
items.text: Could someone volunteer to take the minutes for this meeting?

items.title: Introduce self
items.text: For those who do not know me, I am the product manager for the Asia-Pacific region.

items.title: Present findings
items.text: As you can see from the slide, our revenue grew by thirty percent this quarter.

items.title: Ask question
items.text: I have a quick question about the timeline. When is the expected launch date?

items.title: Clarify point
items.text: Could you clarify what you mean by scalable infrastructure?

items.title: Agree with idea
items.text: That is a great point. I completely agree that we should prioritize mobile users.

items.title: Push back
items.text: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the proposed budget.

items.title: Action items
items.text: To summarize: Sarah will handle the design and Tom will prepare the report by Friday.

items.title: Table discussion
items.text: I suggest we table this discussion and revisit it at next week's meeting.

items.title: Wrap up
items.text: We are running short on time. Let us wrap up and continue over email.

items.title: Meeting follow-up
items.text: I will send the meeting notes and action items to everyone by end of day.

items.title: Technical issue
items.text: Apologies, I am having trouble sharing my screen. Give me a moment.

items.title: Coffee break
items.text: Let us take a ten-minute break and reconvene at half past three.

books.name: 日常闲聊
books.description: Master the art of casual conversation — weather, weekends, hobbies, and everything in between.

items.title: Weather opener
items.text: What terrible weather we are having! Has it been like this all week?

items.title: Weekend plans
items.text: Any exciting plans for the long weekend? Are you going anywhere?

items.title: How was it
items.text: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?

items.title: Watch any shows
items.text: Have you been watching anything good on TV lately? Any recommendations?

items.title: Sports talk
items.text: Did you catch the game last night? What a match it was!

items.title: Holiday plans
items.text: Are you doing anything special for the holidays this year?

items.title: How are you
items.text: Not too bad, thanks! Keeping busy as always. How about yourself?

items.title: Local restaurant
items.text: Have you tried that new Italian place that opened on the high street?

items.title: Hobby question
items.text: What do you like to do to unwind after a long week at work?

items.title: Travel talk
items.text: Have you done much travelling recently? I just got back from Japan.

items.title: Agree and extend
items.text: Oh I know exactly what you mean! I felt the same way when it happened to me.

items.title: Change subject
items.text: Anyway, enough about that! Tell me — how have things been with you?

items.title: Wrap it up
items.text: It has been great catching up! We should do this more often.

items.title: News topic
items.text: Did you hear about the big announcement this morning? What do you think?
